extracted.name: Fried Mashed Potato Cakes
extracted.description: These fried mashed potatoes use just 4 simple ingredients to make delicious, quick, and easy pan-fried potato cakes from leftover mashed potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed
instruction_lines: Mix mashed potatoes, egg, flour, and salt in a bowl until well combined.
Heat a thin layer of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Working in batches, drop 1/6 of the potato mixture into the hot frying pan and flatten into a patty. Repeat to add more patties to the pan. Cook until browned, about 3 minutes per side.
